```text
BLE 广播
  ↓
VK SDK 解析 advertisement
  ↓
Android / iOS native runtime 生成 scanIdentity
  ↓
Pigeon transport bridge
  ↓
Flutter BleDevice.scanIdentity
  ↓
DeviceSearchController._classificationRejection()
  ↓
DeviceSearchPage 展示结果
```

当前各层行为：

1. Android 原生

`NewDeviceScanFragment.refreshShowDevice()` 先通过蓝牙名称查出 `ScanDevice.productId`，再执行：

```kotlin
scanDevice.productId == productId
```

拍摄耳机场景传入 `productId = 25`，所以 Android 原生是严格产品号过滤。

对应文件：

```swift
WKCommonManager.shared.getBLEProductIdWithoutWatch(info.peripheral.name)
```

解析蓝牙名称，只有解析到 `WKProductType.cameraHeadset` 才接受。原生产品号确认是：

```swift
case cameraHeadset = 25
```

对应文件：

[WKDeviceSearchFilter.swift](/Users/jace/Documents/WK/IOS/wearfitpro/ios/howear/Module/MyDevice/DeviceSearch/Filter/WKDeviceSearchFilter.swift:54)

[WKAIAPIConfigration.swift](/Users/jace/Documents/WK/IOS/wearfitpro/ios/howear/Module/AudioEquipment/Components/WKAIAPIManager/WKAIAPIConfigration.swift:39)

3. Flutter native runtime 当前实现

Android 和 iOS 目前只把这些字段传给 Flutter：

```text
category
protocol
advertisementId
codeName
```

没有 `productId`。

而且 iOS 这里已经明确识别到了 `VKAdvertisementDeviceKind.cameraHeadset`，但当前代码把它映射成了 `unknown`：

[PlatformDeviceNativeRuntimePlugin.swift](/Users/jace/Documents/newapp/packages/platform/platform_device_runtime/ios/platform_device_runtime/Sources/platform_device_runtime/transport/PlatformDeviceNativeRuntimePlugin.swift:335)

```swift
case .cameraHeadset: return .unknown
```

这会导致它在 Flutter 控制器的第一层就被拒绝：

[device_search_controller.dart](/Users/jace/Documents/newapp/packages/feature/device/feature_device_search/lib/src/controller/device_search_controller.dart:388)

```dart
if (identity.category == BleScanCategory.unknown) {
  return 'unknown_category';
}
```

4. Flutter 场景层

拍摄耳机当前配置为：

```dart
scanCategory: BleScanCategory.glasses
scanProtocol: BleScanProtocol.vk
productId: 25
```

位置：

[device_routes.dart](/Users/jace/Documents/newapp/apps/glasses_app/lib/integration/device_routes.dart:68)

```dart
DeviceConnectIntent.glasses(
  device: selection.device,
  scanProductId: selection.context.productId,
)
```

它没有参与扫描候选过滤。因此目前实际过滤条件只有：

```text
category == glasses
protocol == vk
```

不是：

```text
category == glasses
protocol == vk
productId == 25
```

- 普通眼镜：基本按 `category + protocol` 过滤。
- 拍摄耳机：未完成产品级过滤。
- iOS 拍摄耳机还会因为 `.cameraHeadset -> unknown` 被 Flutter 提前拒绝。
- 列表专用图标已经接入，但图标接入不代表过滤链路已经完成。

要完全对齐原生，下一步需要改这一整条合同：

```text

  -> DeviceTransportScanIdentityMessage.productId
  -> Pigeon Android/iOS generated bridge
  -> BleScanIdentity.productId
  -> _classificationRejection()
```

Self-contained entry point for coding agents working inside

## What This Package Is

The single Android/iOS native device runtime plugin: private Pigeon bridge, one VK BLE SDK session, raw byte transport, and the identity / settings / network-session / network-settings / file-transfer clients built on top of it. Foundation partition: `packages/platform/` — native SDK artifacts, generated bridges and platform lifecycle adapters live here; platform-neutral contracts and base capabilities remain in Core. Why this package stays one runtime rather than one plugin per capability is [ADR-0007](../../../docs/decisions/0007-single-device-native-runtime.md); its Platform relocation is [ADR-0011](../../../docs/decisions/0011-platform-device-runtime.md). Only stable typed contracts are exported from `lib/platform_device_runtime.dart`; Feature, Common and App code must never import generated bridge types or vendor SDK types directly (see `README.md`).

This package is expected to keep growing: both platforms split SDK adapters by
capability domain. Treat new vendor SDKs, device categories, or capability
domains as additive — keep the existing module boundaries rather than
inventing a new shape per feature.

## Engineering Rules

Hard constraints, boundaries, and the Doc Sync Matrix for this package live in
[`harness/rules.md`](harness/rules.md) — kept local so this plugin does not
depend on the monorepo root harness for everyday rules.

## Fact Priority

When conflicts arise, follow the authority order in
[`docs/INDEX.md`](docs/INDEX.md#fact-priority): this package's own export
surface and bridge contract first, then its own docs and rules, then the
decision/plan record for its shape, then adopted specs and vendor protocol

## Native Platform Constraints

  Android/iOS SDK binaries; do not restore them as build inputs.
- Android: VK modules resolve from the internal Maven repository using published POM
  coordinates. Every consuming App/example root must expose the same repository because
  Flutter plugin dependencies are resolved in the consumer build.
- iOS: the runtime Pod target owns the selected VK Pods resolved from the internal Specs
  repository. Do not restore local XCFramework links or the removed WeiKe source-vendoring

## Pigeon Bridge

Adapter shape, error mapping, cancellation/lifecycle, and binary-data rules for any Pigeon bridge in this workspace are defined once in [`native_bridge`](../../../specs/cross-cutting/native_bridge.md) — do not re-derive them here.

`pigeons/<domain>_bridge.dart` — one private Pigeon schema per capability domain — is the source of truth for that domain's HostApi/FlutterApi contract. Regenerate all of them together from the repository root after any change:

```sh
tool/generate_device_native_runtime_bridges.sh
```

This regenerates every `lib/src/generated/<domain>_bridge.g.dart`, the matching Kotlin `generated/<Domain>Bridge.g.kt` and Swift `Generated/<Domain>Bridge.g.swift` together — never hand-edit any of the generated outputs. Each schema uses its own `fileSpecificClassNameComponent` so generated error classes and DTOs stay distinct across domains even though they compile into the same native module; HostApi/FlutterApi names and channel methods are unchanged from before the split. Generated types stay private to each domain's `impl/` class; `service/` contracts expose only hand-written Dart types.

Why this package stays one runtime rather than one plugin per capability is [ADR-0007](../../../docs/decisions/0007-single-device-native-runtime.md); its Platform relocation is [ADR-0011](../../../docs/decisions/0011-platform-device-runtime.md). Only stable typed contracts are exported from `lib/platform_device_runtime.dart`; Feature, Common and App code must never import generated bridge types or vendor SDK types directly (see `README.md`).

This package is expected to keep growing: both platforms split SDK adapters by
capability domain. Treat new vendor SDKs, device categories, or capability
domains as additive — keep the existing module boundaries rather than
inventing a new shape per feature.

- The root [`SDK/`](../../../SDK/index.md) directory keeps SDK rules, protocol ownership,

- Android: VK modules resolve from the internal Maven repository using published POM

## Pigeon Bridge

Adapter shape, error mapping, cancellation/lifecycle, and binary-data rules for any Pigeon bridge in this workspace are defined once in [`native_bridge`](../../../specs/cross-cutting/native_bridge.md) — do not re-derive them here.

`pigeons/<domain>_bridge.dart` — one private Pigeon schema per capability domain — is the source of truth for that domain's HostApi/FlutterApi contract. Regenerate all of them together from the repository root after any change:

```sh
tool/generate_device_native_runtime_bridges.sh
```

This regenerates every `lib/src/generated/<domain>_bridge.g.dart`, the matching Kotlin `generated/<Domain>Bridge.g.kt` and Swift `Generated/<Domain>Bridge.g.swift` together — never hand-edit any of the generated outputs. Each schema uses its own `fileSpecificClassNameComponent` so generated error classes and DTOs stay distinct across domains even though they compile into the same native module; HostApi/FlutterApi names and channel methods are unchanged from before the split. Generated types stay private to each domain's `impl/` class; `service/` contracts expose only hand-written Dart types.

## 一、核对结论（与原来的判断不同）

| 你的前提 | 实际证据 |
|---|---|
| Android 原生先用蓝牙**名称**查出 `ScanDevice.productId` | 参考实现里 `ScanDevice.productId` 来自 `LTVUtils.getDeviceType(scanRecord)`，即**广播解析**；名称→productId 目录只用于旧 `GlassesSearchActivity` 的白名单准入 |
| iOS 只是 `.cameraHeadset -> unknown` | 除类别丢失外，两端 native 的 `scanIdentity` 根本没有产品号字段，产品类型在 bridge 这一段**整段丢失** |
| 两端"同一个类别" | 两个 SDK 对同一广播字节命名不同：`0xFB` 在 iOS 是 `VKAdvertisementDeviceKind.cameraHeadset`，在 Android SDK 1.8.x 是 `Headphones`（已读本地 SDK 源码 `VKAdvertisement.kt` / `BLEAdvertisementParser.swift`）。所以"按平台枚举名对齐类别"本身就是错的 |

因此真正的修复不是"把 cameraHeadset 改个名字"，而是：**产品号进合同 + 类别以产品号对齐**。

## 二、已实现的链路

`VK SDK product type → Pigeon productId → BleScanIdentity.productId → _classificationRejection() → context.productId == device.scanIdentity.productId`

- 合同：`transport_bridge.dart` 给 `DeviceTransportScanIdentityMessage` 加 `int? productId`，**追加在字段末尾**（Pigeon 是按位置编码的列表，加在中间会错位既有字段），三端桥已重新生成。
- 模型：`BleScanIdentity.productId` / `DeviceTransportScanIdentity.productId`，含 `==`/`hashCode`；`schemaVersion` 保持 `1`（只新增可选字段，不改变既有字段语义）。
- Native 解析（双端同一张表，与 `LTVUtils.getDeviceType` 同源，字节序无关，复用 SDK 自己的厂商字节判定）：`0xFB→25`、`0xF4→11`、`0xFA→23`、`0xF1/F2/F3/F5/F7→2/4/9/12/14`、`0xC0F2→2`，未登记一律 `null`，**不用名称/后端目录补值**。
- 类别对齐：产品号已解析出且属眼镜类时以产品号定中性类别（11/25→`glasses`，23→`audioGlasses`），产品号缺失才回落到 SDK 类别判定 —— 这样 Android 的 `Headphones` 和 iOS 的 `cameraHeadset` 都落到 `glasses`。
- Flutter 过滤：`_classificationRejection()` 在场景声明 `productId` 且广播也解析出产品号时要求相等，否则 `product_id_mismatch`；诊断日志新增 `productId` / `expectedProductId`。条件式而非严格相等，是因为手表场景已声明 `productId: 6`，而广播产品号对非眼镜设备未登记，严格相等会把手表搜索全部拒掉。
- App 宿主场景 `glasses.camera-headset` 已是 `glasses + vk + productId 25`（含专用列表图标），链路两端现在能对上。
